lines.t: We are now at Upper Session Road
Where are you calling me, Lord, with blocked ears and eyes?
You are undone, only I can make this right
I don't sense your calm and patient way, you scratch each one with itchy pride
I don't see you, let me lead
Drew custom maps, then called it guide
My messengers came to feed
By tickling tongues, you starved
If you love my lowest joy
Why bar its door and keep guard?
Where are you?
You hear it echo when I call your name
Where are you?
My altar gathers dust instead of flame
Where are you calling me, Lord, with blocked ears and eyes?
You are undone, only I can make this right
Cannot see myself in you, stained by surrounds to suit your ease
Crunched holy fire with busy chores, with thimble cold you learned to freeze
You spoke great things and won applause, then hid the voice that calls the least
I saw no visits when in prison, my hunger swelled during your feast
Where are you? It just echoes when I call your name
Where are you?
My altar gathers dust instead of flame
Where are you?
Calling me Lord with blocked ears and eyes
You are undone
Only I can make this right
The only anchor is my truth
You drifted after teacher's wind
You kept my place as ornament
What I break down, you cannot mend
You made yourself both judge and church
Watered down my words so it never stung
You hoarded love for self and clan
Then left the wound where mercy hung
Look at yourself
Not as imagined, but as you are
My child, let go of childish ways Discipline is mercy, not the scar
Break now, let the plow turn deep Who seeks a cure except the ill?
Only ruin's sown and truth will keep It's emptiness that can't be filled
Where are you? It just echoes when I call your name
Where are you?
My altar gathers dust instead of flame
Where are you?
Calling me Lord with blocked ears and eyes
When you turn and watch me make this right
Let it shatter
Let your arrogance die
Come empty
Then learn to keep the light
